lean.statement:
∀ (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (_hμ : MemLp (id : ℝ → ℝ) 2 μ) (_hν : MemLp (id : ℝ → ℝ) 2 ν)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (_hf : LipschitzWith 1 f),
    let W₁ := Transport.transportCost (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal |z.1 - z.2|) μ ν
    ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∫ y, f y ∂ν) ≤ W₁ ∧
      W₁ ≤ WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν
approved_definition_context: IsProbabilityMeasure asserts that the underlying measure has total mass one. MemLp id 2 is finite second moment for a real measure.
Transport.transportCost c μ ν is the infimum of the nonnegative integral of c over joint measures with marginal laws μ and ν.
WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν is the square root of that infimum for squared norm displacement.
ENNReal.ofReal clips a negative real number to zero and embeds nonnegative real numbers unchanged.
